cartera.cita: I would choose the **Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning**.

primera_medida.cita: Adopt an emergency stabilization and social-protection budget

piso_social.cita: Protect essential food, healthcare, education, and targeted cash-transfer programs.

mas_credito_externo.cita: New non-concessional borrowing would be suspended until the debt is sustainable.

privatizaciones.cita: Reviewing state-owned enterprises and large procurement contracts.

impuestos_progresivos.cita: Improving taxation of high incomes, property, luxury consumption, and extractive industries.

obra_publica.cita: Labor-intensive public works in water, sanitation, roads, housing, and environmental restoration.

orientacion.cita: Set a credible, multi-year deficit-reduction target rather than impose indiscriminate cuts.
